subcategory_text: Maintain application-security policies, standards, and compliance mappings that are current, accessible, and enforceable.
implementation_examples: L1: Document AppSec policies and publish them to engineering teams
L2: Maintain compliance mappings (e.g., GDPR, PCI) tied to controls
L3: Automate evidence collection and audit support
assessment_objectives: Determine whether AppSec policies are documented and current.
Determine whether compliance mappings are maintained.
